nodes.avoid_direction: Avoid over-investing in tech or air before confirming opponent intentions. Do not neglect defensive structures or unit production.
nodes.decision_direction: Continue developing your economy and expansion while strengthening your ground army. Maintain production and technology at current levels, but be ready to adjust if pressure increases.
nodes.exit_or_recheck_condition: Recheck when you have more information about opponent composition or if you detect an imminent attack. Also recheck when your economy reaches a new saturation point.
nodes.next_state_summary: Proceed to a midgame state with similar macro posture but potentially higher production or tech.
nodes.opponent_situation: Opponent information is limited; assume they may be preparing an aggressive response or expanding themselves. Maintain scouting to detect early pressure.
nodes.own_situation: You have a heavy economy and expansion posture, with moderate production and technology. Your army is ground-oriented with zerglings and queens as representative units. Defense is light or uncertain, and pressure is possible.
nodes.strategic_reason: A heavy economy provides long-term advantage, but you need a sufficient defensive force to deter or hold off early aggression. Queens and zerglings are cost-effective for defense and map presence.
nodes.title: Early-Midgame Ground Macro
nodes.transition_goal: Transition smoothly into the midgame with a solid economy and a defensive ground army, ready to tech into roaches or mutalisks based on scouting.
nodes.trigger_summary: Early-midgame phase with heavy economy and expansion, moderate production, light or uncertain air presence, and possible pressure from opponent.

nodes.avoid_direction: Avoid committing to a single composition too early. Do not neglect upgrades or tech that could be needed later.
nodes.decision_direction: Continue strengthening your ground army, possibly adding more hydralisks for anti-air and ranged damage. Maintain economy and expansion, and consider increasing production if you plan to be more aggressive.
nodes.exit_or_recheck_condition: Recheck when you have a clear read on opponent composition or when your army supply reaches a critical threshold.
nodes.next_state_summary: Move to a late-midgame state with heavier production or a tech switch.
nodes.opponent_situation: Opponent may be transitioning to a different composition or preparing an attack. Keep scouting to identify their tech path.
nodes.own_situation: You have a heavy economy and expansion, moderate defense, and a ground army with zerglings, hydralisks, and queens. Production and tech are moderate.
nodes.strategic_reason: Hydralisks provide a versatile ground unit that can defend against both ground and air threats. Maintaining a strong economy allows you to support a larger army and tech switches.
nodes.title: Midgame Ground Macro with Hydralisk Option
nodes.transition_goal: Transition to a late-midgame posture with a stronger army, either by massing roaches or transitioning to mutalisks if the situation favors air.
nodes.trigger_summary: Midgame phase with heavy economy and expansion, moderate production and technology, ground army including hydralisks, and possible pressure.

nodes.avoid_direction: Avoid over-expanding without sufficient defense. Do not forget to tech towards late-game units like ultralisks or brood lords if the game goes long.
nodes.decision_direction: Continue to strengthen your ground army and increase production if needed. Consider adding upgrades and tech to support your composition. Maintain economy and expansion.
nodes.exit_or_recheck_condition: Recheck when you have a clear picture of the opponent's army composition or when you are ready to take a decisive engagement.
nodes.next_state_summary: Proceed to a late-game state with a fully developed army and tech.
nodes.opponent_situation: Opponent may be preparing a large attack or transitioning to a late-game composition. Maintain map vision and scouting.
nodes.own_situation: You have a heavy economy and expansion, heavy production, moderate defense, and a ground army with zerglings and queens. Technology is moderate.
nodes.strategic_reason: Heavy production allows you to remax quickly after engagements. Upgrades become increasingly important as the game progresses.
nodes.title: Late-Midgame Heavy Ground Production
nodes.transition_goal: Transition to a late-game army composition that can handle the opponent's final push, whether that be ground or air.
nodes.trigger_summary: Late-midgame phase with heavy economy, expansion, and production, moderate technology, and a ground-oriented army.

nodes.avoid_direction: Avoid making risky tech investments before you have a read on the opponent. Do not overproduce units at the expense of economy.
nodes.decision_direction: Focus on increasing your economy and maintaining a defensive posture. Continue producing queens and zerglings for defense and creep spread.
nodes.exit_or_recheck_condition: Recheck when you have scouted the opponent's base or when you are about to take a third base.
nodes.next_state_summary: Move to an early-midgame state with continued economic development.
nodes.opponent_situation: Opponent is likely also in the early game, possibly expanding or preparing an early pool. Scout to determine their build.
nodes.own_situation: You are in the early game with a heavy economy and expansion posture. Production is moderate, technology is light or uncertain, and your army consists of zerglings and queens.
nodes.strategic_reason: A strong economy early sets the foundation for a powerful midgame. Queens are essential for defense and injects.
nodes.title: Early Game Economy Focus
nodes.transition_goal: Transition to the early-midgame with a solid economy and a defensive army, ready to expand further or tech up.
nodes.trigger_summary: Early game phase with heavy economy and expansion, moderate production, light or uncertain technology, and possible pressure.

nodes.avoid_direction: Avoid over-committing to defense at the expense of economy. Do not delay tech too long, as you may fall behind in army strength.
nodes.decision_direction: Stabilize your defense while continuing to grow your economy. Increase production and technology gradually, but prioritize safety.
nodes.exit_or_recheck_condition: Recheck when you have a clear idea of the opponent's plan or when your economy is saturated.
nodes.next_state_summary: Proceed to a midgame state with more production and tech.
nodes.opponent_situation: Opponent may be preparing an aggressive push or expanding. Maintain scouting to detect threats.
nodes.own_situation: You have a heavy economy and expansion, heavy defense, moderate production, and a ground army with zerglings and queens. Technology is light or uncertain.
nodes.strategic_reason: Heavy defense ensures you can hold off early aggression while your economy grows. This is a safe approach that allows for flexible transitions.
nodes.title: Early-Midgame Defense and Economy
nodes.transition_goal: Transition to a midgame posture with a stronger army and tech, ready to take map control.
nodes.trigger_summary: Early-midgame phase with heavy economy and expansion, heavy defense, moderate production, and possible pressure.

nodes.avoid_direction: Avoid being too greedy if you suspect an early all-in. Do not neglect scouting.
nodes.decision_direction: Increase your economy and expansion further, and ramp up production. Maintain a light defensive force but focus on macro.
nodes.exit_or_recheck_condition: Recheck when you have scouted the opponent's army composition or when you are about to take a fourth base.
nodes.next_state_summary: Move to a midgame state with heavy production.
nodes.opponent_situation: Opponent may be aggressive or expanding. Use overlords and speedlings to scout.
nodes.own_situation: You have a heavy economy and expansion, light defense, moderate production, and a ground army with queens. Technology is light or uncertain.
nodes.strategic_reason: This is a greedy approach that aims to out-economy the opponent. It is viable if you can defend with minimal units and rely on early warning.
nodes.title: Early-Midgame Expansion and Production
nodes.transition_goal: Transition to a midgame with a strong economy and production, ready to mass an army.
nodes.trigger_summary: Early-midgame phase with heavy economy and expansion, light or uncertain defense, moderate production, and possible pressure.

nodes.avoid_direction: Avoid being too passive; you need to take map control eventually. Do not forget to add anti-air if the opponent goes mutalisks.
nodes.decision_direction: Strengthen your ground army with roaches and maintain a defensive posture. Continue to grow your economy and tech towards upgrades.
nodes.exit_or_recheck_condition: Recheck when you have a clear read on the opponent's composition or when you are ready to attack.
nodes.next_state_summary: Proceed to a late-midgame state with heavier production or tech.
nodes.opponent_situation: Opponent may be preparing a roach push or transitioning to mutalisks. Scout to determine.
nodes.own_situation: You have a heavy economy and expansion, heavy defense, moderate production, and a ground army with roaches and queens. Technology is moderate.
nodes.strategic_reason: Roaches are a durable and cost-effective unit for defending and pushing. Heavy defense allows you to safely expand and tech.
nodes.title: Midgame Roach Defense
nodes.transition_goal: Transition to a late-midgame with a powerful roach army or a tech switch to mutalisks if needed.
nodes.trigger_summary: Midgame phase with heavy economy and expansion, heavy defense, moderate production, and a ground army with roaches and queens.

nodes.avoid_direction: Avoid over-committing to mutalisks if the opponent has strong anti-air. Do not neglect your ground army.
nodes.decision_direction: Increase your air presence and strengthen your air army. Continue to grow your economy and maintain production.
nodes.exit_or_recheck_condition: Recheck when you have scouted the opponent's anti-air capabilities or when you have dealt significant damage.
nodes.next_state_summary: Move to a late-midgame state with a strong air presence.
nodes.opponent_situation: Opponent may be unprepared for air. Use mutalisks to harass and gain map control.
nodes.own_situation: You have a heavy economy and expansion, moderate defense, heavy production, and a ground army with zerglings, mutalisks, queens, and overseers. Technology is moderate.
nodes.strategic_reason: Mutalisks provide mobility and harassment potential, forcing the opponent to react. This can give you a tempo advantage.
nodes.title: Midgame Mutalisk Transition
nodes.transition_goal: Transition to a late-midgame with a strong mutalisk force, or switch back to ground if the opponent adapts.
nodes.trigger_summary: Midgame phase with heavy economy and expansion, moderate defense, heavy production, and a ground army with mutalisks and overseers.

nodes.avoid_direction: Avoid being too defensive; you need to be proactive to win. Do not forget to upgrade your units.
nodes.decision_direction: Continue to strengthen your ground army and tech towards late-game units. Increase defense if needed, but also consider taking map control.
nodes.exit_or_recheck_condition: Recheck when you have a clear picture of the opponent's army or when you are ready to take a decisive engagement.
nodes.next_state_summary: Proceed to a late-game state with a fully developed army.
nodes.opponent_situation: Opponent may be preparing a large attack or transitioning to a late-game composition. Maintain scouting.
nodes.own_situation: You have a heavy economy and expansion, heavy defense, heavy production, and a ground army with roaches and queens. Technology is heavy.
nodes.strategic_reason: Heavy tech and production allow you to field a powerful army. Roaches are a solid core, but you may need to add other units for composition.
nodes.title: Late-Midgame Roach Heavy Defense
nodes.transition_goal: Transition to a late-game army with ultralisks or brood lords, or a mix of units to counter the opponent.
nodes.trigger_summary: Late-midgame phase with heavy economy, expansion, production, and technology, heavy defense, and a ground army with roaches and queens.

nodes.avoid_direction: Avoid losing your mutalisk flock to poor engagements. Do not neglect your ground defense.
nodes.decision_direction: Continue to increase your air presence and use mutalisks for harassment. Maintain your economy and production, and consider adding upgrades.
nodes.exit_or_recheck_condition: Recheck when you have scouted the opponent's anti-air or when you have dealt significant damage.
nodes.next_state_summary: Move to a late-game state with a strong air presence.
nodes.opponent_situation: Opponent may be transitioning to a ground army with anti-air. Use mutalisks to harass and force reactions.
nodes.own_situation: You have a heavy economy and expansion, heavy defense, heavy production, and a ground army with zerglings, mutalisks, queens, and overseers. Technology is moderate.
nodes.strategic_reason: Mutalisks can be very effective in the late-midgame if the opponent is not prepared. They can also transition into a larger air army.
nodes.title: Late-Midgame Mutalisk Harass
nodes.transition_goal: Transition to a late-game with a strong air army or a mixed composition.
nodes.trigger_summary: Late-midgame phase with heavy economy, expansion, and production, heavy defense, and a ground army with mutalisks and overseers.

opening.flexibility_note: This is a strategic template, not a fixed build order. Adapt based on live scouting and opponent posture.
opening.opening_summary: A Zerg versus Zerg opening focused on heavy economy and expansion while maintaining a ground-oriented posture with moderate production and technology. The early game emphasizes queens and zerglings, transitioning into a flexible midgame that can support either roach-based ground armies or a mutalisk switch depending on live observations.
opening.strategic_goal: Develop a strong economic and expansion lead while preserving flexibility to adapt to opponent actions. Prioritize macro consistency, creep spread, and queen production to secure map control and tech options.
